content: Claude connectors (claude.com/docs/connectors/building, fetched 2026-11-27): Streamable HTTP (SSE legacy); tools, prompts, resources; text+image tool results; text+binary resources; NOT supported: resource subscriptions, sampling, draft capabilities (file transfers beta, directory-only). OAuth: DCR + CIMD by default, PKCE S256 mandatory, callback https://claude.ai/api/mcp/auth_callback (hosted) + loopback any port (Claude Code); 401 + WWW-Authenticate resource_metadata required; refresh proactive 5 min before expiry, rotate refresh tokens; OAuth endpoints must answer <10s (refresh 30s). Lazy auth supported (public tools before sign-in). Limits: ~150,000 chars tool result on claude.ai/Desktop, 240s tool timeout; Claude Code 25k tokens default. Free plan: ONE custom connector. Install link: https://claude.ai/customize/connectors?modal=add-custom-connector&connectorName=NAME&connectorUrl=ENCODED_URL. Egress 160.79.104.0/21. Request headers alongside OAuth: beta, limited orgs.
